verdicts.reason: Both have the same main faults. The rose is clipped with a hard vertical edge at about x=260, the whole bottom-right half is empty, and the centred stack is broken into a ragged staircase with no shared axis. A puts the divider right against 'When Life Is Great', so it reads like a cramped quote bar. B pushes the second block almost to the right edge (about 25px margin) and leaves the divider floating on its own, so it looks more scattered.
